title: Transport one integral supported localization to the rational stage
statement: Fix a field $k$, a prime $\ell$ and a proof $h_\ell$ that $\ell$ is invertible in $k$. Let $t:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be separated and of finite type, and let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion with complementary open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow X$. Use the records of [def-sf-localization-stage-data]. Let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite and suppose an integral localization record $I$ for this coefficient field and immersion pair is given. Then the rational localization record $\mathrm{SfRationalLocalization}(\ell,E,k,h_\ell,t,i,j)$ is nonempty.

proof.text: Identify the integral image functors with the ordinary completed-ring restrictions using the supplied I comparisons. Adjoint additivity, coefficient linearity and the induced shifts make the five functors exact linear functors, with compatible adjunctions. Apply [lem-sf-rational-supported-adjoint-transport] to this data. Identify the raw localization with the published rational category. Uniqueness of the extensions of the pullbacks identifies them with the functors of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. The transported comparisons give the three unit/counit equations; retain I as the integral field.

lean.statement: theorem sfRationalLocalizationConstruction (k : Type u) [Field k] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : IsUnit (l : k)) (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (X : Scheme.{u}) (t : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSeparated t] [LocallyOfFiniteType t] [QuasiCompact t] {Z U : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) (j : U ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsOpenImmersion j] (hij : Set.range j = (Set.range i)ᶜ) (I : SfIntegralLocalization l E k hl t i j) : Nonempty (SfRationalLocalization l E k hl t i j)
